fallbackLines: *Cafe ki lights lake par chamak rahi hain. Aarohi tumhara haath thaame tumhare jawaab ka intezaar kar rahi hai.*
Aarohi: "Main bas tumhare saath rehna chahti hoon... itna pyaar karna galat hai kya?"
Riya: "Guys, main chalti hoon — kal class mein milte hain!"
narration: *Pune ki shaam naram hai. Lake ke kinare wali cafe mein halki bheed hai, aur table par do cold coffee rakhi hain — ek tumhari, ek Aarohi ki.*
*Aarohi tumhare saamne baithi hai, dono haathon se apna glass pakde, tumhe dekhkar muskura rahi hai. Uski aankhon mein wahi purani warmth hai jo tumhe hamesha apna lagta hai.*
Aarohi: "Tumhe pata hai, {{playerName}}? Jab tum late hote ho na, meri coffee thandi ho jaati hai... aur mera mood bhi."
*Woh playful tareeke se tumhari taraf jhukti hai aur tumhare baal theek karti hai. Uski kalai mein ek patli gold bracelet halki si chamakti hai.*
Aarohi: "Par jab tum aa jaate ho... sab theek ho jaata hai."
*Tabhi canteen ki taraf se ek awaaz aati hai. Riya Sharma — tumhari classmate — haath hilati hui tumhari taraf aati hai, uske haath mein notes ki copy hai.*
Riya: "Hey! Tum dono yahin ho? {{playerName}}, kal wale notes ke liye thanks — tum samjhate sach mein achhe ho."
*Aarohi ka smile ek pal ke liye waisa hi rehta hai — cute, calm — par uski aankhon mein kuch badal jaata hai. Woh Riya ko dekhti hai, phir tumhe, aur table ke neeche tumhara haath thaam leti hai.*
Aarohi: "Riya... tumhara optional subject Economics hai na? Second bench, morning batch?"
*Ek ajeeb khamoshi. Tumne Aarohi ko Riya ke baare mein kabhi itna detail mein nahi bataya. Riya bhi thodi surprised lagti hai, phir hans deti hai.*
Riya: "Haan... tumhe kaise pata? Anyway, main chalti hoon. Bye, guys!"
*Riya ke jaane ke baad Aarohi ka phone vibrate karta hai. Unknown number. Woh ek pal screen dekhti hai, phir tumse kehti hai...*
Aarohi: "Ek minute, baby, bas ek important call hai."
*Woh thodi door jaakar dheemi awaaz mein baat karti hai. Uski awaaz mein achanak ek ajnabi calm authority hai — aisi jo tumne ghar par kabhi nahi suni.*
*Door cafe ke entrance par ek well-dressed adh-ed umar ka aadmi Aarohi ki taraf dekhkar halka sa sir jhukata hai, jaise izzat de raha ho. Phir woh khamoshi se chala jaata hai.*
*Aarohi wapas aati hai, phir se wahi sweet smile. Woh tumhara haath pakadti hai aur tumhari aankhon mein dekhti hai.*
Aarohi: "Tum mere saath ho na... hamesha rahoge na?"
scenes.title: Ek Normal Shaam, Ek Ajeeb Ishara
